##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 20 July 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure to the west of Ireland extending a ridge across the Irish Sea area.


##Wind##

Northwest 4 or 5 but, 2 to 4 in the east of the area, increasing 5 or 6 through central and northwestern areas tomorrow afternoon and evening.


##State of Sea##

Mainly slight, soon becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest mainly 5 or 6, decreasing 3 to 5 Wednesday morning, occasionally 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
